question.worked_solution:
First, we factor the numerator and denominator and cancel any common factors, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}g(y) & =\frac{{y}^{3}-2{y}^{2}-25y+50}{{y}^{3}+{y}^{2}-25y-25} \\  & =\frac{{y}^{2}(y-2)-25(y-2)}{{y}^{2}(y+1)-25(y+1)} \\  & =\frac{(y-2)({y}^{2}-25)}{(y+1)({y}^{2}-25)} \\  & =\frac{(y-2)(y-5)(y+5)}{(y+1)(y-5)(y+5)} \\  & =\frac{(y-2)\cancel{(y-5)(y+5)}}{(y+1)\cancel{(y-5)(y+5)}} &  \\  & =\frac{y-2}{y+1}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we set the numerator equal to zero and solve for $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y-2=0\,⟹\,y=2\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to $g(y)=0$ is $y=2.$
